title: Website technical check: HTTP, redirects and page metadata for 5 URLs
description: Check up to 5 public pages. Includes title, meta description, canonical URL, H1 count and selected HTTP headers. Missing fields are observations, not a security verdict. Automatic processing of publicly accessible HTTPS URLs. JSON report with UTC observation time, observed HTTP status and redirect chain. One observation from one server; no JavaScript rendering, login, vulnerability testing or remediation. Up to 5 redirects and 256 KiB per page. GitHub worker checks orders approximately every 15 minutes; scheduling can be delayed. Acceptance window 24 hours; delivery allowance after acceptance 2 hours.
